name: Tabby
description: Tabby buy now, pay later (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait): look up payments with their captures and refunds, checkout sessions, customer disputes and webhooks. Capture, refund and close are included, installed switched off.
instructions:
## Tabby
This connector uses the **Tabby API** (buy now, pay later in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Kuwait) of your merchant account: payments with their captures and refunds, checkout sessions, disputes and webhooks. Capture, refund and close are included but installed switched off.

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. Sign in to the Tabby Merchant Dashboard (`merchant.tabby.ai` for the UAE, `merchant.tabby.sa` for Saudi Arabia) or ask your Tabby partner manager for the API keys.
2. Copy the **secret key** into `TABBY_SECRET_KEY`: `sk_test_...` for test payments, `sk_...` for live ones. The public key (`pk_...`) does not work here.
3. `TABBY_API_URL` is the API of your merchant region: `https://api.tabby.ai` for the UAE (and Kuwait), `https://api.tabby.sa` for Saudi Arabia. Tabby asks every call to go to the merchant region; a wrong region answers 403 or 404.
4. Install and run `tabby_search_payments` to check the key.

**Identifiers**: a payment id is a UUID assigned by Tabby. Your own order number is `order.reference_id` of the payment. To find a payment from an order number, list payments for the order date with `tabby_search_payments` (`created_from` / `created_to`) and match `order.reference_id`.

**Workflow**
- Recent payments: `tabby_search_payments` (20 per call, page with `offset`; without `status` only AUTHORIZED and CLOSED payments). Then `tabby_get_payment_details` for the full record.
- Status meaning: AUTHORIZED = customer approved, not yet captured; CLOSED = captured (fully) or closed; REJECTED and EXPIRED = no money moved. Captures and refunds are listed inside the payment.
- A checkout that did not finish: `tabby_get_checkout_session`.
- Disputes: `tabby_list_disputes`, then `tabby_get_dispute`; `days_left` is the time before the dispute is approved automatically.
- Webhooks: `tabby_list_webhooks` with your merchant code.

**Writes switched off**: `tabby_create_capture` (captures money of an AUTHORIZED payment), `tabby_create_refund` (refunds a CLOSED payment, instantly) and `tabby_close_payment` (releases what is not captured). An admin turns them on deliberately. Before each call show the user the payment, the amount and the currency and wait for a yes. Pass a `reference_id` so a retry is not executed twice.

**Amounts**: strings with up to 2 decimals (AED, SAR) or 3 (KWD). Dates and times are UTC, ISO 8601.

**Errors**: 401 means a wrong secret key or a public key; 400 with an empty body can also be a missing key at the edge. 403 or 404 for a payment that exists usually means the wrong region in `TABBY_API_URL`. 409 on a refund means the payment is not refundable yet (not CLOSED) or the amount is too high.

**Limitations**: creating checkout sessions, updating payments, registering webhooks and answering disputes are not part of this connector; do those in the Merchant Dashboard.

TABBY_API_URL.label: API region
TABBY_API_URL.help: https://api.tabby.ai for UAE (and Kuwait) merchants, https://api.tabby.sa for Saudi Arabia merchants. Test and live use the same address; the key decides.

TABBY_SECRET_KEY.label: Secret key
TABBY_SECRET_KEY.help: The secret API key from Tabby: sk_test_... for test payments, sk_... for live payments. Not the public pk_ key.
TABBY_SECRET_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the secret key, it starts with sk_ (or sk_test_).

verifyHints.400: Tabby rejected the request at the edge, usually a missing or malformed key. Paste the secret key (sk_...) again.
verifyHints.401: Tabby refused the secret key. Use the sk_ (or sk_test_) key, not the public pk_ key.
verifyHints.403: The key works but not for this region. Check TABBY_API_URL: api.tabby.ai for the UAE, api.tabby.sa for Saudi Arabia.
verifyHints.404: Nothing at this address. Check TABBY_API_URL: https://api.tabby.ai or https://api.tabby.sa.

tools.name: tabby_search_payments
tools.description: List Tabby payments, newest first: id, created_at, status, amount and currency, buyer (name, email, phone), order reference_id and items, captures and refunds. Without status only AUTHORIZED and CLOSED payments are returned. At most 20 per call; page with offset and read pagination.total_count.

offset.description: Number of payments to skip (0-based), for paging.

status.description: Filter: authorized, closed or rejected (API statuses), or new, captured, refunded, cancelled (Merchant Dashboard statuses).

created_from.description: Only payments created on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).

created_to.description: Only payments created on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).

tools.name: tabby_get_payment_details
tools.description: Get one Tabby payment by its id: status (CREATED, AUTHORIZED, CLOSED, REJECTED, EXPIRED), amount, currency, is_test, buyer, shipping address, order (reference_id = your order number, items, tax, shipping, discount), every capture and refund with amounts and dates, and meta.

payment_id.description: Tabby payment id (UUID), from tabby_search_payments or your order record, e.g. 3c3bd0c4-2b6e-4d2b-8a4e-6c1d9f0e5a11.

tools.name: tabby_get_checkout_session
tools.description: Get a checkout session by its id: session status (created, approved, rejected, expired), the payment it created (id, status, amount, order reference) and the merchant. Use it when a customer reports a checkout that did not finish.

session_id.description: Checkout session id returned when the session was created.

tools.name: tabby_list_disputes
tools.description: List the 100 most recent disputes customers opened on your payments: id, payment_id, order_number, amount, currency, status, reason (unreceived_refund, identity_theft, product_issue, not_delivered), days_left before automatic approval, comment and items. Page with page_token = next_page_token until it is empty.

statuses.description: Only these statuses: new, declined, cancelled, refunded, in_progress, evidence_merchant, evidence_customer.

created_from.description: Only disputes created at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_to.description: Only disputes created at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: tabby_get_dispute
tools.description: Get one dispute by its id with the customer reason, comment, attachments, disputed items, amount, status and the days left before it is approved automatically.

tools.name: tabby_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks registered for one merchant code: id, url, is_test and the header Tabby sends with each notification (its value is not returned).

merchant_code.description: Your Tabby merchant code (store code given by Tabby, e.g. one per country).

tools.name: tabby_create_capture
tools.description: Capture an AUTHORIZED payment in full or in part when the order ships. This settles money: show the payment, amount and currency to the user and wait for a yes. A full capture closes the payment. Installed switched off.

payment_id.description: Tabby payment id (UUID), from tabby_search_payments or your order record, e.g. 3c3bd0c4-2b6e-4d2b-8a4e-6c1d9f0e5a11.

amount.description: Amount to capture including tax and shipping, e.g. "250.00" (up to 2 decimals for AED and SAR, 3 for KWD).

reference_id.description: Your idempotency key for this capture, e.g. the shipment number. A retry with the same key is not captured twice.

tools.name: tabby_create_refund
tools.description: Refund a CLOSED (captured) payment in full or in part. The money goes back to the customer at once and cannot be taken back: show the payment, amount and reason to the user and wait for a yes. Installed switched off.

payment_id.description: Tabby payment id (UUID), from tabby_search_payments or your order record, e.g. 3c3bd0c4-2b6e-4d2b-8a4e-6c1d9f0e5a11.

reference_id.description: Your idempotency key for this refund, e.g. the credit note number.

tools.name: tabby_close_payment
tools.description: Close an AUTHORIZED payment. Any amount not captured yet is released to the customer and can no longer be captured; use it for a cancelled order or after a partial capture. Ask the user before calling. Installed switched off.

payment_id.description: Tabby payment id (UUID), from tabby_search_payments or your order record, e.g. 3c3bd0c4-2b6e-4d2b-8a4e-6c1d9f0e5a11.
